items.exampleEn: Getting my first job was a significant event in my life.
items.exampleZh: 得到第一份工作是我人生中的重大事件。

items.exampleEn: My bag is similar to yours.
The plants in my garden are all dead.
items.exampleZh: 我花園裡的植物全都死了。

items.exampleEn: This game is simple, so even children can play it.
items.exampleZh: 這個遊戲很簡單，連小孩都會玩。

items.exampleEn: This shop sells clothes of good quality.
items.exampleZh: 這家店賣的衣服品質很好。
請說得慢一點、清楚一點。

items.exampleEn: This song is very popular with young people.
items.exampleZh: 這首歌很受年輕人歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The river is very wide here.

items.sentenceEn: Which singer is popular right now?

items.audioEn: The two jackets look similar, but the black one is better quality.
items.audioZh: 這兩件外套看起來很像，但黑色那件品質比較好。
items.questionZh: 哪一件外套品質比較好？

items.sentenceEn: The street is wide and quiet.

items.stemEn: Give the plants some water, or they will be ____.
items.stemZh: 幫植物澆水，不然它們會枯死。

items.stemEn: I can't read your writing. Please write more ____.
items.stemZh: 我看不懂你寫的字，請寫清楚一點。

items.passageEn: Last year, two cafes opened on my street. At first, they looked similar. Both were small, with simple tables and chairs. But there was a significant difference in quality. One cafe's coffee was clearly better, and it soon became popular. The other cafe was often empty, and now it is closed.
items.passageZh: 去年，我家這條街開了兩家咖啡店。一開始，它們看起來很像，都很小，擺著簡單的桌椅。但兩家的品質差很多：其中一家的咖啡明顯比較好喝，很快就受到歡迎。另一家常常沒有客人，現在已經關門了。

questions.questionZh: 兩家咖啡店一開始看起來怎麼樣？
另一家咖啡店後來怎麼了？

items.promptZh: 這兩張照片看起來很像。
referenceEn: The two photos look very similar.
rubricZh: 「看起來很像」可寫例如 look similar、look very similar、are similar
look 後面接形容詞（look similar，不寫 look similarly）
複數主詞配原形動詞（例如 photos look）

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳很受遊客歡迎。
referenceEn: This restaurant is popular with tourists.
This restaurant is very popular with visitors.
rubricZh: 用 popular with（或 among）表示「受…歡迎」（例如 popular with tourists 等）
